title: Bridge and Harbor
author: August Kavanagh
blurb: Wendell Vane, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent seven years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
